frozen_identity.question: Will the Ornn B200 Index be at least $7.00 on December 31, 2026?

literal_metric.source: Ornn B200 Index finalized daily chart value
literal_metric.rule: Only the finalized value for the specified Dec31 date matters. A daily value is finalized once the following day’s point is published. If not finalized by ET end of the seventh calendar day after target date, use latest available then.

official_series.route_basis: Exact same-origin route and GPU name exposed by linked public dashboard frontend code; no guessed host/API path.
official_series.span: The API returns public-3mo history only; first point is 2026-07-19, nine days after market creation, so earlier history/max is not covered.

finalization_and_limits.latest_data_asof_capture: 2026-10-18T20:00:00Z (8.54); capture was 2026-10-19 16:47:00Z, before expected timestamp of a same-day 20:00Z point. Under the literal rule, Oct18 remains not demonstrably finalized until Oct19’s point is published.
finalization_and_limits.interpretation: 8.54 is the latest provisional value and the max of this returned three-month window; neither decides the Dec31-only criterion. The full eligible history begins at market creation July10, but the endpoint starts July19.

scope: Facts only; no Polymarket quotes, probability, or trade judgment.
